intro.text: A prominent Veden lighteyes whose lands in Highprince Valam's princedom border Lin Davar's; the two men are rivals for the highprince's favour.

items.text: Revilar lost his nose in a duel when he was young.

In 1169 and early 1170, Revilar worked hard to win Highprince Valam's favour, improving the princedom's textile trade. His son's skill as a duelist also caught the highprince's eye, and Valam visited Revilar's estates to show his approval.

At the Middlefest Fair on the Davar grounds, Revilar pressed Lin into selling him breachtree cotton and raw shum below cost. He reminded Lin of Valam's growing favour and of House Davar's poor reputation and failing finances; Lin, furious but desperate for allies, agreed.

appearance.text: Silver-haired and well dressed, he has no nose and wears a wooden replacement painted black; he would otherwise be handsome.

personality.text: He often looks distracted but is calculating and self-serving, a capable businessman and politician.
